newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens downgraded to "hold" from "buy" - Goldman.
newsitem.headline: Siemens downgraded to "hold" from "buy" - Goldman.

text.p: The research arm of U.S. investment bank Goldman Sachs in London said on Tuesday it has downgraded shares in German electronics giant Siemens AG to "hold" from "buy".

"Our opinions differ most from Siemens management in the public communications and semi-conductor sectors -- these are the sectors where there could be the biggest downgrades," a Goldman Sachs source told Reuters.
In late bourse trade in Frankfurt, Siemens shares were down 74 pfennigs at 77.72 marks, compared to the overall DAX index which was up 0.81 percent.
